description: Fisher's exact test for a 2x2 table [[a, b], [c, d]]: two-sided and both one-sided p-values (computed in log space, so a tiny p keeps its real exponent), the sample odds ratio, and the conditional maximum-likelihood odds ratio with its exact confidence interval (what R's fisher.test reports). For two genes: a = tumours with both altered, b = gene A only, c = gene B only, d = neither. Up to 100,000 observations. The same implementation as cybergenic.im/tools/fisher-exact-test.

a.description: Row 1, column 1 (for two genes: both altered).

alternative.description: Which p-value is the headline and which interval is reported. greater: odds ratio above 1.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level for intervals, between 0.5 and 0.9999. Default 0.95.

name: fisher_exact_test
title: Fisher's exact test (2x2)
